Hello Morgan,

Your export finished at 14:32 UTC. The archive contains 128 invoices and the account summary for September. Please check the billing address before sending it to your accountant. If the download expires, open Settings → Exports and create a new link.

Thanks,
The support team

We keep a bounded cache because request traffic changes throughout the day. A dashboard refresh often repeats the same query, while an overnight import may introduce thousands of new keys. Cache eviction must preserve correctness: a miss can cost time, but it cannot change the answer. Measure the warm dashboard and the import separately before choosing a capacity.

Release notes

The editor now restores unsaved drafts after a restart. Search results include archived projects when the filter is enabled. We fixed a race between reconnecting a session and loading its history. Existing API keys continue to work. Administrators can enable the new audit log on the organization settings page.

Known issue: very large attachments may take several seconds to appear.

-- Daily active accounts, excluding internal traffic
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS day,
       count(DISTINCT account_id) AS active_accounts
FROM request_events
WHERE created_at >= $1 AND created_at < $2
  AND environment = 'production'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY day DESC;
